decisions.reason: Because it builds on the established offer and benefits from existing capabilities and market demand, its results likely meet the firm's aspirations.
As an incremental extension of the established construction dumper range, it likely performs close to historical returns and stays above aspiration.
Being distant from the established offer, it likely falls short of aspirations and triggers problemistic search that favours releasing resources to closer activities.
As a multi-model line building on core loader capabilities, it represents a deliberate investment that is likely performing satisfactorily and is supported by slack.
